meta.source: Reserve Bank of India (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Policy rates and auction results are final when announced. The Handbook restates a few effective dates between editions (newest edition wins, differences listed in rates-policy meta). Lending and deposit rates: each monthly release repeats the full history; the newest release wins.
meta.coverage: Call money in detail: borrowing and lending sides, their rate ranges and amounts, every trading day since April 2005
meta.note: RBI, Daily Weighted Average Call/Notice Money Rates (DBIE report 198, Handbook of Statistics), ACTUALS rows. One row per day the market traded. The weighted average call rate is the RBI's operating target since May 2011. The ranges are printed as text ('4.40-6.10') and split into their low and high ends.
